_meta.plan: CSWA + FE Electrical + ML/Hardware Master Plan

milestones.title: Resume v1 + GitHub cleaned
milestones.description: Job-funnel prerequisite. Resume v1, clean GitHub READMEs, LinkedIn open-to-work.

milestones.title: Job apps OPEN — new-grad 2027 ML/Hardware
milestones.description: Begin applying to early new-grad cohorts (NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, ADI, TI, Apple HW, MedTech). Cycles fill fast.

milestones.title: CSWA Practice Test #1 (benchmark)
milestones.description: Official CSWA sample exam. GATE: need >=80% before scheduling the real exam (margin over 70% bar).

milestones.title: CSWA EXAM — SIT
milestones.description: Sit CSWA once mock >=80%. HARD GATE: CSWP content forbidden until this is PASSED.

milestones.title: Portfolio P1 shipped — Wearable Biosignal Classifier
milestones.description: ESP32 + AD8232/MyoWare -> on-device DSP filter -> serial/BLE stream. Build-log + demo clip.

milestones.title: CSWP Segment 1 — Part Modeling
milestones.description: ~70 min, 75/105 pts. Attempt when timed drills are consistent. 14-day retake rule applies.

milestones.title: CSWP Segment 2 — Configurations & Design Tables
milestones.description: ~50 min, 77/104 pts. ZERO CSWA overlap — dedicated 2-3 week study block.

milestones.title: FE Reference Handbook + FE MOC seeded
milestones.description: Download NCEES FE Reference Handbook, build navigation map, create FE MOC. Triple-overlap on-ramp only.

milestones.title: CSWP Segment 3 — Assemblies & Interference
milestones.description: ~80 min, 77/109 pts. Longest segment. On pass -> CSWP COMPLETE, CAD track closed.

milestones.title: FE REGISTRATION via MyNCEES
milestones.description: Do NOT defer to April. Register + get authorization, schedule Pearson VUE seat for mid-May.

milestones.title: Portfolio P2 shipped — ECG Arrhythmia ML Pipeline
milestones.description: PyTorch 1D-CNN on PhysioNet MIT-BIH -> ONNX/TFLite export -> Next.js/RN dashboard.

milestones.title: FE Practice Exam #1 (NCEES official, timed)
milestones.description: First full-length. Log score + per-domain gap map in FE/PE tracker.

milestones.title: Portfolio P3 shipped — HW Accelerator (FPGA/MCU)
milestones.description: FIR filter or NN inference on FPGA (Verilog, Tang Nano) or quantized model on STM32; benchmark vs CPU.

milestones.title: FE Full-length #2 (PrepFE, 5.5h sim)
milestones.description: Weekend simulation. Target >=70% before sitting the real FE.

milestones.title: FE ELECTRICAL & COMPUTER EXAM — SIT
milestones.description: 5.5-hour Pearson VUE exam. Taper week prior. CONFIRM exact date at registration and snap the taper to it.

studyBlocks.title: CSWA part-modeling drill (AM)
studyBlocks.description: Phase 1 core. Sketch relations, extrude/revolve/sweep/loft, patterns, fillets. 14/23 CSWA Q live here.

studyBlocks.title: Overlap: Linear Algebra (3B1B) (PM)
studyBlocks.description: Triple-overlap seed. 3Blue1Brown Essence of Linear Algebra -> atomic notes.

studyBlocks.title: Overlap: Circuit Analysis (Khan) (PM)
studyBlocks.description: Triple-overlap seed. DC then AC (phasors/impedance). Links to Instrumentation MOC.

studyBlocks.title: ML foundation: Andrew Ng ML Spec (PM)
studyBlocks.description: Phase 1 ML. Ng ML Specialization C1 (regression, gradient descent).

studyBlocks.title: CSWP bridge + segment drills (AM)
studyBlocks.description: Phase 2-3. Link values/equations, multi-body, hole wizard, ribs, draft; then Seg1/2/3 timed drills.

studyBlocks.title: ML ramp: DL Spec + PyTorch (PM)
studyBlocks.description: Phase 2. Ng DL Spec C1-C2 + PyTorch tensors/autograd + 1D-CNN on biosignal.

studyBlocks.title: Overlap keep-warm: Fourier/DSP (Brunton) (PM)
studyBlocks.description: Phase 2. Steve Brunton FFT/convolution -> atomic notes.

studyBlocks.title: FE Circuit Analysis (AM+PM)
studyBlocks.description: Phase 3 highest-weight FE domain. Asghar Circuits + 40+ PrepFE problems, timed.

studyBlocks.title: FE Linear Systems + Signal Processing
studyBlocks.description: Phase 3 triple-overlap. Laplace, transfer functions, Fourier. Asghar + PrepFE.

studyBlocks.title: FE Electronics + Digital Systems
studyBlocks.description: Phase 3 triple-overlap. Diodes/BJT/op-amps, logic/FSM/K-maps. Asghar + PrepFE.

studyBlocks.title: FE Power + EM + Control
studyBlocks.description: Phase 3 low-BME-overlap domains — need the reps most. Asghar Power/EM/Controls.

studyBlocks.title: FE Comms + Networks + Computer/Software
studyBlocks.description: Phase 3 remaining domains. Then NCEES full practice exam.

studyBlocks.title: FE weak-domain repair + full-length sims (AM+PM)
studyBlocks.description: Phase 4 peak. Target lowest 4 domains from gap map; PrepFE full-lengths; handbook speed-drills.
